definitions.full: H2762. charakkim חֲרַכִּים noun [masculine] plural lattice or other opening through which one may look (Aramaic ᵑ7 חֲרַכָּא Josh 2:15 and elsewhere=Hebrew חַלּ֖וֺן ; but Late Hebrew חֲרָךְ is an opening smaller than a window) — only מִןהַֿח ׳מֵצִיץ Song 2:9 peeping in at the lattice (|| מִןהַֿחַלֹּנוֺת מַשְׁגִּיחַ ). חרל (√ of following; meaning unknown).
